title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: Prescribed Person
tiers.description: An employee, Director, Partner, Affiliate or Responsible Manager of the Company or of RFM Farming Pty Ltd; the immediate family of such a person; a family company, SMSF or family trust of such a person; and any body corporate or entity controlled by such a person. Covers all full-time, part-time and casual employees and any officer, consultant, agent, representative or independent contractor acting for the Company.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of the Company; together with Key Management Personnel, must lodge a Compliance Certificate before dealing.

tiers.name: Key Management Personnel
tiers.description: The chief financial officer, financial controller, company secretary, chief operating officer, and any other persons having authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling the Company's activities, excluding Directors. Must lodge a Compliance Certificate before dealing.

tiers.name: Managing Director
tiers.description: The Managing Director; the primary approver of exceptional-circumstances clearance to deal during a Prohibited Period, unless the circumstances relate to the Managing Director personally.

tiers.name: Chairman of the Board
tiers.description: The Chairman; approves exceptional-circumstances clearance for the Managing Director.

tiers.name: Immediate Family / Family Entities
tiers.description: The immediate family of a Prescribed Person, and a family company, self-managed superannuation fund or family trust of such a person; automatically deemed Prescribed Persons in their own right rather than a separately bolted-on associate class.

windows.start_anchor: 2 weeks before the Appendix 4D (Half-Year Financial Report) announcement date
2 weeks before the Appendix 4E (Preliminary Financial Report) announcement date
issue of an offer document in relation to an offer of RFF or RFP securities

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board and/or Company Secretary may impose further black-out periods as they consider necessary, and the Board reserves the right, in its absolute discretion, to impose an ad-hoc restriction on Dealing during any period outside the Prohibited Periods. Confidentiality of such additional restrictions is not addressed.

rules.detail: No standalone derivatives rule. 'Dealing' includes granting, accepting, acquiring, disposing, exercising or discharging an option or other right or obligation to acquire or dispose of securities, which covers an OTC put or call. Ordinary Prescribed Persons may Deal without a formal clearance step provided they have no Inside Information and are outside a Prohibited Period.
rules.evidence: Dealing Includes any acquisition or disposal of, or agreement to acquire or dispose of securities or to grant, accept, acquire, dispose, exercise or discharge an option or other right or obligation to acquire or dispose of securities and Deal has a corresponding meaning.

rules.detail: The same Dealing definition applies to Key Management Personnel and Directors, who must additionally lodge a self-certifying Compliance Certificate confirming no Inside Information before dealing, and must deal within 10 business days of lodgment.
rules.evidence: Before any Key Management Personnel or Director Deals in RFF or RFP securities, they must first complete a Compliance Certificate and submit it to the Company Secretary or the Company Secretary's delegate.

rules.detail: Hedging is not named anywhere in the policy. A hedge transaction over RFF/RFP securities involves granting or acquiring an option or other right/obligation and is therefore a Dealing, permitted for ordinary Prescribed Persons subject only to the no-Inside-Information and Prohibited Period gate.
rules.evidence: Dealing Includes any acquisition or disposal of, or agreement to acquire or dispose of securities or to grant, accept, acquire, dispose, exercise or discharge an option or other right or obligation to acquire or dispose of securities and Deal has a corresponding meaning.

rules.detail: A hedge over RFF/RFP securities is a Dealing; Key Management Personnel and Directors must lodge a Compliance Certificate before entering it and deal within 10 business days of lodgment. No hedging-specific ban or approval exists.
rules.evidence: Before any Key Management Personnel or Director Deals in RFF or RFP securities, they must first complete a Compliance Certificate and submit it to the Company Secretary or the Company Secretary's delegate.

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named. A prepaid forward or similar is an agreement to dispose of securities and so a Dealing, permitted for ordinary Prescribed Persons subject to the no-Inside-Information and Prohibited Period gate.
rules.evidence: Dealing Includes any acquisition or disposal of, or agreement to acquire or dispose of securities or to grant, accept, acquire, dispose, exercise or discharge an option or other right or obligation to acquire or dispose of securities and Deal has a corresponding meaning.

rules.detail: Monetisation of securities held by Key Management Personnel or Directors is a Dealing requiring a lodged Compliance Certificate and execution within 10 business days.
rules.evidence: Before any Key Management Personnel or Director Deals in RFF or RFP securities, they must first complete a Compliance Certificate and submit it to the Company Secretary or the Company Secretary's delegate.

rules.detail: Short selling is not mentioned anywhere in the policy.
Securities lending is not mentioned anywhere in the policy.

CFDs are not mentioned. Unlike an option or a right/obligation over securities, a cash-settled CFD does not involve acquiring or disposing of the underlying securities, so it may sit outside the narrow Dealing definition; the position is not addressed.

Margin lending is not directly regulated by a standalone rule. The reference to an 'approved margin lending arrangement' in the Excluded Dealing carve-out implies Company approval is required to enter one, though the approval process itself is not otherwise specified in this policy.
rules.evidence: disposals by a secured lender exercising their rights, for example, under an approved margin lending arrangement.

rules.detail: Encumbrance is not named as such and is not covered by the Dealing definition (which is limited to acquisitions, disposals and options/rights over securities). The 'approved margin lending arrangement' reference implies some approval gate for granting security, but it is not otherwise specified.
rules.evidence: disposals by a secured lender exercising their rights, for example, under an approved margin lending arrangement.

rules.detail: The only textual touchpoint is 'an approved margin lending arrangement' in the excluded-dealing carve-out; the policy neither bans secured financing generally nor sets out its approval process, so a bank facility not styled as margin lending sits in an unaddressed gap.
rules.evidence: disposals by a secured lender exercising their rights, for example, under an approved margin lending arrangement.

rules.detail: No minimum holding period or short-term dealing restriction is stated anywhere in the policy.

clearance.evidence: Subject to section 4.3, a Prescribed Person may Deal in RFF, RFP securities and the securities of any other listed entity which the Company is responsible entity for, if: (a) they do not have Inside Information; (b) it is outside a Prohibited Period; and (c) in the case of Key Management Personnel or Directors, following lodgment of a Compliance Certificate.

clearance.approver: Company Secretary or the Company Secretary's delegate
clearance.evidence: Receipt of the Compliance Certificate by the Company is intended as a compliance monitoring function only, and is not an endorsement of the proposed transaction ... If Dealing is to occur, the Dealing must occur within 10 business days of lodgment of the Compliance Certificate.

clearance.approver: Managing Director (or the Chairman where the circumstances relate to the Managing Director)
clearance.evidence: Where it can be reasonably established that exceptional circumstances exist, the authorisation to Deal in securities must be given by either: the Managing Director; or the Chairman (where the circumstances relate to the Managing Director). ... Authorisation is only valid for 2 business days.

exceptions.evidence: transfers of securities already held by a Prescribed Person into a superannuation fund or other saving scheme in which the Prescribed Person is a beneficiary;

where a Prescribed Person is a trustee, Dealing by that trustee provided the Prescribed Person is not a beneficiary of the trust and any decision to Deal during a Prohibited Period is taken by the other trustees or by the investment managers independently of the Prescribed Person;
undertakings to accept, or the acceptance of, a takeover offer;

exceptions.approver: Board (approves timing and structure of the offer)
exceptions.evidence: Dealing under an offer or invitation made to all or most of the security holders, such as a pro-rata rights issue, a security purchase plan and an equal access buy-back, where the timing and structure of the offer has been approved by the Board

Dealing under a distribution reinvestment plan where: (a) the Prescribed Person do not commence or amend their participation in the plan during a Prohibited Period; and (b) the Prescribed Person is not permitted to withdraw from the plan during a Prohibited Period other than in exceptional circumstances and with the appropriate consent;
disposals by a secured lender exercising their rights, for example, under an approved margin lending arrangement.

the exercise (but not the sale of securities following exercise) of an option or a right under an employee incentive scheme, or the conversion of a convertible security, where the final date for the exercise of the option or right, or the conversion of the security, falls during a Prohibited Period;

Dealing under a non-discretionary trading plan for which prior written clearance has been provided in accordance with this Policy provided the Prescribed Person did not enter into the plan or amend the plan during a Prohibited Period and the trading plan does not permit the Prescribed Person: to exercise any influence or discretion over how, when, or whether to Deal

exceptions.approver: Managing Director (or the Chairman where the circumstances relate to the Managing Director)
exceptions.evidence: severe financial hardship where the persons financial commitments can only be met by selling their securities;

exceptions.approver: Managing Director (or the Chairman where the circumstances relate to the Managing Director)
exceptions.evidence: court order or a court enforceable undertaking (for example a bona fide family settlement); or other overriding legal or regulatory requirement to transfer, or accept a transfer of, securities.

exemption_authority: The Managing Director (or the Chairman, where the circumstances relate to the Managing Director) may authorise dealing during a Prohibited Period in extraordinary circumstances (severe financial hardship, a court order or enforceable undertaking, another overriding legal or regulatory requirement to transfer securities, or other circumstances an Executive Manager, the Managing Director or the Chairman determines to be exceptional); authorisation is valid for 2 business days only, after which re-authorisation is required.
jurisdiction_overlays: NSX Listing Rules and other guidance (RFP is listed on the National Stock Exchange of Australia)

bespoke_clauses.topic: no express hedging or margin lending ban
bespoke_clauses.clause: Dealing Includes any acquisition or disposal of, or agreement to acquire or dispose of securities or to grant, accept, acquire, dispose, exercise or discharge an option or other right or obligation to acquire or dispose of securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unlike most trading policies, RFF does not prohibit hedging or margin lending outright; a funded collar's derivative legs are simply a 'Dealing' via the option/right language and subject only to the ordinary Prohibited Period, no-Inside-Information and (for KMP/Directors) Compliance Certificate gate, making this an unusually permissive framework.

bespoke_clauses.clause: disposals by a secured lender exercising their rights, for example, under an approved margin lending arrangement.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The only reference to margin lending is this phrase in the excluded-dealing carve-out; the policy does not specify who approves a margin loan or on what terms, leaving a bank's secured facility without a clearly defined approval pathway, though also without an express prohibition.

bespoke_clauses.topic: secured lender forced sale excluded from the whole policy
bespoke_clauses.clause: This Policy does not apply to: ... disposals by a secured lender exercising their rights, for example, under an approved margin lending arrangement.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Because Excluded Dealings sit outside the policy altogether, a lender's enforcement sale under an approved margin lending arrangement is excluded even from the Compliance Certificate and Prohibited Period requirements, giving the bank an unusually clean enforcement path on default.

bespoke_clauses.topic: compliance certificate is not an approval
bespoke_clauses.clause: Receipt of the Compliance Certificate by the Company is intended as a compliance monitoring function only, and is not an endorsement of the proposed transaction: individuals remain responsible for their own investment decisions and their compliance with the law.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even for Directors/KMP there is no discretionary company approval step to negotiate around for a collar's derivative legs; the only gate is self-certification of no Inside Information, then a 10-business-day window to execute.

bespoke_clauses.topic: board and company secretary ad hoc discretion
bespoke_clauses.clause: The Board reserves the right, in its absolute discretion, to impose an ad-hoc restriction on Dealing during any period outside the Prohibited Periods under this policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even outside the fixed half-year/preliminary-results black-out periods, the Board or Company Secretary can impose additional restrictions at any time, adding timing risk to entry, roll or unwind of a collar.

summary: A funded collar is plausible under this policy, which is unusually light-touch on hedging: hedging and derivatives are never named or banned, so an OTC put and written call over RFF securities is simply a 'Dealing' (granting or acquiring an option or right to acquire or dispose of securities), permitted for ordinary Prescribed Persons once outside a Prohibited Period and free of Inside Information, and for Key Management Personnel or Directors after lodging a self-certifying Compliance Certificate (valid 10 business days). The loan leg is the weaker point: the policy's only reference to secured financing is the phrase 'approved margin lending arrangement' in the Excluded Dealing carve-out for a lender's forced sale, implying some approval gate exists without specifying its process, terms or approver, and it is unclear whether a bank facility not styled as margin lending is covered at all. If the loan is treated as a margin lending arrangement, a lender's enforcement sale on default is fully excluded from the policy, including its black-out periods, giving the bank a clean enforcement path. Both legs must still avoid the twice-yearly two-week pre-results black-out periods and any Board or Company Secretary ad hoc restriction, and Directors/KMP must clear the derivative legs via Compliance Certificate before dealing.
